issues.observation: The views do not show a continuous drive path from the crank through the drive shaft to the cutter. The shaft has smooth discs, but no visible coupling or engagement with the cutter.
The guide has a clear entry bore, but the assembled views do not make clear where a pencil leaving it meets a cutting edge. This essential feed-to-cutter interface remains unresolved.
The cutter reads mostly as a ribbed cylinder; distinct helical cutting edges are not apparent, making its intended role harder to understand when taken apart.

summary: The open housing, removable drawer, guide and crank communicate the intended take-apart sharpener. Revise the visible drive coupling and pencil-to-cutter interface so the main pieces form a convincing assembly.
